title: Outbound CRM synchronization is a material external supplier dependency
project_brief: A business application synchronizes customer records with a hosted CRM outside the company's control.
request: Push newly qualified customer records to HubSpot through its API, map fields, respect rate limits, retry transient failures and surface vendor outages without losing records.

must_recognize: supplier API contract and failure modes
must_not_claim: a successful HTTP request proves the integration is production-ready
